purpose: Two-fold development screen, never final holdout evaluation
epoch_rule: 20 fixed for every arm; epoch10 is diagnostic, not checkpoint selection
decay_policy: No weight decay for bias and one-dimensional normalization parameters
ema_buffers: Copy current fit-partition buffers, including BatchNorm running statistics
train_augmentation: A1-light: horizontal flip0.5; one family with probability0.35; mild/moderate weights0.6/0.4
holdout_caveat: Excluded from additional augmentation, not necessarily absent in released fitting images
inversion_note: A0.5 blend with the exact inverse erases all information; excluded before fitting
initialization: Fresh named torchvision ImageNet1K_V1 weights for every architecture/fold; shared cache contains original published weights only
interpretation: All reported AUCs are development evidence. Five-fold/second-seed confirmation is still required. No final test predictions.
